name: zkworld
title: zkworld · a multi-framework ZK workbench
description: A zero-knowledge workbench for any framework. Scaffold a project, vibecode it with an agent, build it, run its tests and run it on inputs: Cairo (Starknet contracts, live devnet app), Circom, Noir, ZoKrates, Leo (Aleo), gnark (Go) and halo2 (Rust) are driven directly; every other framework in the catalog (RISC Zero, SP1, Jolt, OpenVM, arkworks, Plonky3, o1js, ...) plugs in through the runner protocol. Projects share one test format (tests/*.json), so the same statement is checked in every framework: compare() runs one input through every port, port_to() has the agent re-implement a project in another framework held to the same cases. Two kinds of submod live under orbit/zkworld/src/mods/: each framework is a running mod of its own (zkworld.cairo, zkworld.noir, ... each with its own server, port and page at /zkworld/<id>/), and each project is a mod (zkworld.<name>) owned by its framework. Forked from orbit/cairo.

custom.any: the project config.json zk block names build/test/run

state: Projects live in-tree as mods at orbit/zkworld/src/mods/<name>/ (one framework project + mod.py anchor each, addressed zkworld.<name>). Build output (target/, .snfoundry_cache/) is gitignored. The cairo sandbox chain (starknet-devnet) keeps its state in src/.sandbox/ (gitignored, dumped every block).

endpoints.GET /zkworld/api/toolchain: scarb / snforge / sncast / claude presence + versions
endpoints.GET /zkworld/api/get?name=: One submod: Scarb.toml, files, build state
endpoints.GET /zkworld/api/read?name=&path=: Read a file inside a submod
endpoints.POST /zkworld/api/new: Scaffold a project (name, desc?, template?, framework?=any catalog id; framework inferred from template). A catalog framework with no adapter (risc0, sp1, arkworks, ...) gets a runner-protocol project (config.json zk preset + RUNNER.md)
endpoints.POST /zkworld/api/write: Write a file inside a submod (name, path, content)
endpoints.POST /zkworld/api/build: Build with the project framework compiler (scarb build | circom | nargo compile); async=true -> job
endpoints.POST /zkworld/api/test: Test with the project framework runner (snforge | circom JSON cases | nargo test); no name = module self-test; async=true -> job
endpoints.POST /zkworld/api/vibe: Agent-edit then build + test (name, prompt, model?); async=true -> job
endpoints.note: The app self-calls the same handlers under /zkworld/_api/*; /api/zkworld/* is the permanent legacy alias.
endpoints.POST /zkworld/api/adopt: Pull legacy root-level contracts into src/mods/ and (re)write each one's mod.py/README/config anchor
endpoints.GET /zkworld/api/templates: Starter projects new() can scaffold, every framework (framework= narrows)
endpoints.GET /zkworld/api/abi?name=: Built contract classes: entrypoints, constructor, events, Sierra/CASM size
endpoints.GET /zkworld/api/whoami: Can this caller write? {writable, via, address, owners}
endpoints.GET /zkworld/<contract>/: That project's app: its own src/mods/<c>/app/index.html, else its framework default (cairo: src/templates/cairo/app.html over the devnet; circuits: src/templates/circuit.html over witness)
endpoints.GET /zkworld/api/app?name=: Everything the app page needs: ABI, sandbox deployment, accounts, custom-page flag (boots the devnet)
endpoints.POST /zkworld/api/deploy: Declare + deploy on the local devnet (name, args={ctor arg: value}, account?). Open only if built and not already live; owner otherwise (cairo only)
endpoints.POST /zkworld/api/call: Call an entrypoint on the sandbox (name, fn, args={name: value}, account=alice|bob|carol|dave). View -> decoded result; external -> tx + decoded events. Open (cairo only)
endpoints.GET /zkworld/api/events?name=: Decoded events of the deployed contract, newest first
endpoints.GET /zkworld/api/sandbox: Devnet status, accounts, deployments; POST action=start|stop|reset is owner-only
endpoints.GET /zkworld/api/market: The bazaar: every contract with build state, ABI summary (reads/writes/events), devnet deployment, size, last touched; plus starter templates
endpoints.POST /zkworld/api/fork: Copy a contract into a new mod (src, name, desc?): package, contract module, dispatchers and use-paths renamed. Owner-only
endpoints.GET /zkworld/api/tutorials?id=: The LEARN track: stablecoin + Cairo lessons for beginners (no id = index + glossary)
endpoints.POST /zkworld/mcp: MCP server (JSON-RPC 2.0, streamable HTTP): zkworld_tutorials/lesson/templates/contracts/app/read/abi/call/events/deploy/jobs open; zkworld_new/write/build/test owner-only. GET = card; zkworld_fork/zkworld_vibe owner-only (vibe starts a job), zkworld_job open
endpoints.GET /zkworld/agents: Agent contract: the zkworld helper (brains: helper = free/open, claude = owner-only via orbit/claudecode)
endpoints.POST /zkworld/run/stream: Ask the helper {query, brain?, context:{contract,view,lesson,account}} -> SSE step... done{answer, actions}; every read is an MCP tool call
endpoints.GET /zkworld/api/fleet: Every mod on this box with a ZK setup in any framework (Scarb.toml, Nargo.toml, *.circom, else config mentions), nearest-mod attribution; ?refresh=1 skips the 60s cache
endpoints.POST /zkworld/agents/builder/run/stream: The BUILDER agent (owner-only, agent contract SSE): {query, name?, template?, fork?, new?, vibe?, model?, context:{contract}} -> makes a contract (new from a guessed/given starter, or fork) or edits an existing one via orbit/claudecode, then build + snforge test. Runs as a normal 'vibe' job; streams its steps; done{answer, contract, mode: make|edit, job, actions}. Same as POST /zkworld/run/stream with agent:'builder'
endpoints.GET /zkworld/api/frameworks?id=: Every ZK framework: `frameworks` = the 8 adapters (cairo, circom, noir, zokrates, leo, gnark, halo2, custom) with tools/starters; `catalog` = all 29 (circuit DSLs, zkVMs, libraries), driven or via the runner protocol with a preset; `protocol` = the shared case format + runner contract. id= one
endpoints.POST /zkworld/api/witness: Run a project (any framework but cairo) on inputs (name, input={name: value}) -> accepted + outputs, or the constraint that rejected them. Names the program doesn't take are ignored. Open
endpoints.GET /zkworld/api/statements: Statements (config.json `statement`) and the projects implementing each, one per framework
endpoints.GET /zkworld/api/compare?statement=&name: Run ONE input through every port of a statement (or listed projects): holds/rejected per framework, outputs, ms, agree. Open
endpoints.POST /zkworld/api/port_to: Re-implement a project in another framework (src, framework, name?, model?): new target, src tests/*.json copied as the spec, agent rewrites until every case passes; same statement. Owner; async=true -> job
endpoints.GET /zkworld/api/submods: The framework submods: each framework is a running mod zkworld.<id> (cairo :51353, circom :51354, noir :51355, zokrates :51356, leo :51357, gnark :51358, halo2 :51359, custom :51360) with its projects; POST action=up|restart|sync is owner-only
endpoints.* /zkworld/<framework>/: Proxied to that framework submod's own server (src/api/fwserver.py): / = its page (toolchain, starters, its projects), /api/<fn> = info health toolchain templates projects abi witness jobs job (open) + new build test vibe clean (owner, gated here). async=true -> job

safety: vibe() runs the coding agent with --permission-mode acceptEdits scoped to a single submod directory (--add-dir), so edits and scarb/snforge runs stay inside that contract's project. It uses the host Claude OAuth credentials and spends against them. No keys are deployed and nothing is sent to a live chain; sncast is present for the user to deploy by hand. Publicly routed: reads are open, but every write (write/new/vibe/build/test/clean/remove/adopt) needs a loopback request or a mod-protocol token signed by the owner (config owner, build-console private-flag owner, or ZKWORLD_OWNERS). The per-contract apps run on a local starknet-devnet with its public seed-0 test accounts; nothing reaches a real network. call() and witness() are open to anyone; deploy() is open only for a built contract with no live deployment; sandbox start/stop/reset is owner-only.

layout.src/mod.py: anchor: new / vibe / build / test / ... (Python stdlib)
layout.src/api/server.py: stdlib HTTP server: protocol API + job table + serves the console
layout.src/build.sh: build the console -> src/releases/<ts>, flip src/dist atomically
layout.src/templates: starters per framework: src/templates/<framework>/<id>/ (+ shared manifests), mod.py.tmpl (per-project anchor), circuit.html (default circuit app)
layout.src/mods/<name>/: one project MOD per dir, addressed zkworld.<name>: a framework project + mod.py (parent fns bound to it) + config.json (framework) + README.md
layout.src/sandbox.py: local starknet-devnet: process, ABI codec (values <-> felts), keccak selectors, deploy/call/events via sncast + JSON-RPC
layout.src/.sandbox/: devnet dump, sncast accounts file, deployments.json (gitignored)
layout.src/mods/<name>/app.json: optional Simple-view layer: labels, hidden inputs/outputs, visuals, event sentences
layout.src/tutorials.py: LEARN lessons + glossary (plain data; console, MCP and helper all read it)
layout.src/api/zkworld_mcp.py: MCP server: tools = thin wrappers over mod.py fns, same gate as REST
layout.src/api/zkworld_helper.py: the corner helper on the agent contract; reads via MCP tools in-process
layout.WHITEPAPER.md: the whitepaper (console: Paper view; MCP: zkworld_whitepaper)
layout.src/api/zkworld_builder.py: the builder agent: make-or-edit a contract over the agent contract (new/fork -> vibe job -> build + test)
layout.src/frameworks.py: one adapter per ZK framework (Cairo, Circom, Noir, ZoKrates, Leo, gnark, halo2) + Runner (the runner protocol) + Custom (config.json zk block) + CATALOG of 29 frameworks; shared tests/*.json statement cases run through every adapter's witness()
layout.src/templates/cairo/app.html: the default per-contract app (one plain HTML file, no build)
layout.src/templates/circuit.html: the default app of every non-cairo project (inputs form -> witness -> accepted/rejected)
layout.src/mods/<framework>/: one FRAMEWORK submod per adapter (zkworld.cairo, zkworld.noir, ...): mod.py rendered from src/templates/fwmod.py.tmpl + config.json (kind: framework, port) + README; a running service that owns that framework's projects
layout.src/api/fwserver.py: the server of one framework submod (loopback, its own port); the parent supervises it every 20s and proxies /zkworld/<fid>/
layout.src/templates/framework.html: the page of every framework submod

mcp.add: claude mcp add --transport http zkworld http://localhost:51350/zkworld/mcp
